subject.title: Support compat reasoning levels for thinking xhigh

question: Should OpenClaw accept `supportedReasoningEfforts` and `reasoningEffortMap` as the maintainer-approved Completions and Responses compat contract for custom OpenAI-compatible reasoning models?
rationale: The code path looks coherent, but this changes provider/model capability exposure and outbound provider strings for configured custom models, so a maintainer/provider owner must bless the compatibility contract rather than leaving it to automation.

options.title: Accept Expanded Compat Contract
options.body: Merge this PR after ordinary maintainer review, treating the explicit compat fields and conservative `max` gate as the supported custom-provider contract.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Ask the author to reduce the PR to a smaller already-approved subset, such as Completions-only or capability-only, and track Responses/payload mapping separately.

options.title: Pause For Provider API Direction
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers decide a different plugin/provider API should own extended reasoning-effort mapping.

recommendation.title: Accept Expanded Compat Contract
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after ordinary maintainer review, treating the explicit compat fields and conservative `max` gate as the supported custom-provider contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the earlier configured `xhigh` compat work and is the clearest prior owner for accepting or narrowing this contract.
